title: AIPersona
description: JSON Schema specification for Open-Source AI Character Personas

$schema.description: URL to schema.json for editor validation and autocomplete

id.description: Unique numeric persona identifier (TTCCNN or open-ended TTCCNNN+)

name.description: Full display name of the character (e.g., Hatsune Miku)

calling.description: Short primary summon alias / trigger keyword (lowercase, single word, e.g., miku)

description.description: Comprehensive summary of the character identity, role, and lore

personality.description: Core personality traits, emotional disposition, and behavioral quirks

appearance.description: Physical traits, clothing, hair, eyes, and distinctive visual elements

features.description: Key lore facts, abilities, weapons, origins, or notable background details

behavior.description: Condition -> Reaction behavior patterns demonstrating character reactions to scenarios

scenario.description: Contextual setup / scene background setting for dialogue and interaction

first_message.description: Default opening greeting or introductory line spoken by the character

keywords.description: Keywords that trigger injection of this lore entry

content.description: Lorebook / RAG background knowledge injected when keywords are mentioned

world_info.description: Lorebook entries activated by keywords in user dialogue

content.description: Character's feelings, history, and dynamics toward this related person

relationships.description: Key relationships with other characters in their universe

char.description: Example character response demonstrating tone, formatting, and personality

example_dialogues.description: Few-shot dialogue examples showing speech style, tone, and action formatting

speech_patterns.description: Optional speech quirks, catchphrases, pronouns, or verbal tics

visual.description: Visual character traits for AI image generation (Danbooru tags & prompts)

trigger_words.description: Character name and series Danbooru/Booru tags (e.g. ['hatsune miku', 'vocaloid'])

character_tags.description: Distinctive visual traits in Danbooru tag format (hair, eyes, signature outfit)

negative_prompt.description: Custom negative prompt additions for this character
